items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: His brother, Johnny, played piano with the original Crescent City Jazzers

ctx.x: That's what I thought. With that beautiful wide tone. How can anybody get a wide tone on piano? Jeff does.

Well, it's just that touch he has. Hmm. And his brother, too. He's from a musical family. His brother, Johnny, played piano with the original Crescent City Jazzers, which was out of Mobile. I never did know why they called themselves the original Crescent City Jazzers. Everybody wants to cash in on the Crescent City, maybe. Well, you find that all over the world. Whether you go to Japan or England or Germany, they'll have something that reminds you of New Orleans.

They all slightly originated here, too, and then got over on the Gulf Coast in order to get a job. You know, it's almost impossible for a jazz man to get a job in New Orleans. I don't know whether you know that or not. He said cynically.
